resource: Australian Bureau of Meteorology Water Data Online, native daily mean water-temperature series

metadata_recruitment.uncertain_medium_or_geometry: pending verification; retained in candidate ledger rather than promoted to eligible or scored as zero
metadata_recruitment.catchment_source: BoM Geofabric V3.3 official Station Catchments layer 49
metadata_recruitment.station_number_matching: exact provider station number; union duplicate matching polygons conservatively; no guessed suffix aliases

roles.assignment: fixed order of all members of a metadata-connected catchment component before daily reference acquisition

daily_reference.quality_interpretation: provider best-available record; not an error-free physical truth guarantee
daily_reference.statistic: provider time-weighted daily mean with documented minimum 90-percent source coverage
daily_reference.missing_aggregation_accuracy: retain provider documented daily-mean definition; never invent a coverage percentage
daily_reference.time_definition: provider local standard calendar day; convert explicit timestamps to verified owner-state standard offset before assigning dates
daily_reference.complete_year: every calendar date including leap day has a finite quality-A daily mean
daily_reference.duplicate_rule: identical duplicates collapse; conflicting finite approved means make the day unavailable; an empty duplicate does not erase a valid approved mean
daily_reference.zero_flow: not automatically dry: monitored pools can retain water; wet status remains qualified by provider temperature QC

predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.primary_point: old-only selected air32 CSDI H30 point, 32 conditional draws
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.candidate: matched-capacity direct failure-probability boosting with window summaries
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.normalization: strictly prior complete local water history and prior local air history; target-year hidden temperatures never determine normalization
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.source_F0: serialize old opened Swiss-development heads and old calibration thresholds before new daily temperature acquisition
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.F1: unchanged probability model and heads, target-calibration thresholds
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.F2: unchanged probability model, identical-capacity heads refitted on new development groups, target calibration
predictive_choice_before_new_recovery_re.new_test_error_access: sealed pending complete reference and independence qualification, recruitment/power review and an evaluation lock

planned_evaluation.primary_admission_masks: unchanged broadened admission generator: 14/30/60/90/120/180/270-day gaps and pre-fixed empirical-calendar templates; all feasible cases and unsupported predictions retained
planned_evaluation.controlled_mechanisms: separate balanced placement/length and nested-gap assays
planned_evaluation.boundary_fragment_history_sensitivities: separate supports; histories 3/5/10 compared on common feasible target years
planned_evaluation.natural_missingness: not supplied by constructed masks or provider reaggregation; independent backup references remain a distinct unmet requirement
planned_evaluation.small_reference_pool: report actual support and planning infeasibility; never relabel masks or years as new independent groups
